units.text: INT. SUPERMAN - CONTINUOUS
Good.
units.name: DON JUAN

units.text: saluting Dona Ana.
Senora: your servant.
units.name: DON JUAN

units.text: But I am going with you.
units.name: ANA

units.text: I can find my own way to heaven, Ana; but I cannot find yours
units.name: DON JUAN

units.text: he vanishes.
How annoying!
units.name: ANA

units.text: calling after him.
Bon voyage, Juan!
units.name: THE STATUE

units.text: He wafts a final blast of his great rolling chords after him as a parting salute.
A faint echo of the first ghostly melody comes back in acknowledgment.
Ah! there he goes.
units.name: THE STATUE

units.text: Puffing a long breath out through his lips.
Whew! How he does talk! They'll never stand it in heaven.
units.name: THE STATUE

units.text: gloomily.

His going is a political defeat. I cannot keep these Life Worshippers: they all go. This is the greatest loss I have had since that Dutch painter went--a fellow who would paint a hag of 70 with as much enjoyment as a Venus of 20.
units.name: THE DEVIL

units.text: I remember: he came to heaven. Rembrandt.
units.name: THE STATUE

units.text: Ay, Rembrandt. There a something unnatural about these fellows. Do not listen to their gospel, Senor Commander: it is dangerous. Beware of the pursuit of the Superhuman: it leads to an indiscriminate contempt for the Human. To a man, horses and dogs and cats are mere species, outside the moral world. Well, to the Superman, men and women are a mere species too, also outside the moral world. This Don Juan was kind to women and courteous to men as your daughter here was kind to her pet cats and dogs; but such kindness is a denial of the exclusively human character of the soul.
units.name: THE DEVIL

units.text: And who the deuce is the Superman?
units.name: THE STATUE

units.text: Oh, the latest fashion among the Life Force fanatics. Did you not meet in Heaven, among the new arrivals, that German Polish madman--what was his name? Nietzsche?
units.name: THE DEVIL

units.text: Never heard of him.
units.name: THE STATUE

units.text: Well, he came here first, before he recovered his wits. I had some hopes of him; but he was a confirmed Life Force worshipper. It was he who raked up the Superman, who is as old as Prometheus; and the 20th century will run after this newest of the old crazes when it gets tired of the world, the flesh, and your humble servant.
units.name: THE DEVIL

units.text: Superman is a good cry; and a good cry is half the battle. I should like to see this Nietzsche.
units.name: THE STATUE

units.text: Unfortunately he met Wagner here, and had a quarrel with him.
units.name: THE DEVIL

units.text: Quite right, too. Mozart for me!
units.name: THE STATUE

units.text: Oh, it was not about music. Wagner once drifted into Life Force worship, and invented a Superman called Siegfried. But he came to his senses afterwards. So when they met here, Nietzsche denounced him as a renegade; and Wagner wrote a pamphlet to prove that Nietzsche was a Jew; and it ended in Nietzsche's going to heaven in a huff. And a good riddance too. And now, my friend, let us hasten to my palace and celebrate your arrival with a grand musical service.
units.name: THE DEVIL

units.text: With pleasure: you're most kind.
units.name: THE STATUE

units.text: This way, Commander. We go down the old trap
units.name: THE DEVIL

units.text: he places himself on the grave trap.
Good.
units.name: THE STATUE

units.text: Reflectively.
All the same, the Superman is a fine conception. There is something statuesque about it.
units.name: THE STATUE

units.text: He places himself on the grave trap beside The Devil.
It begins to descend slowly.
Red glow from the abyss.
Ah, this reminds me of old times.
units.name: THE STATUE

units.text: And me also.
units.name: THE DEVIL

units.text: Stop!
units.name: ANA

units.text: The trap stops.
You, Senora, cannot come this way. You will have an apotheosis. But you will be at the palace before us.
units.name: THE DEVIL

units.text: That is not what I stopped you for. Tell me where can I find the Superman?
units.name: ANA

units.text: He is not yet created, Senora.
units.name: THE DEVIL

units.text: And never will be, probably. Let us proceed: the red fire will make me sneeze.
units.name: THE STATUE

units.text: They descend.
Not yet created! Then my work is not yet done.
units.name: ANA

units.text: Crossing herself devoutly.
I believe in the Life to Come.
units.name: ANA

units.text: Crying to the universe.
